body:
In 🐾 Pets on the phone: a new button "🩺 Book the vet".
1. Shows your sick pets. None sick: "All your pets are well".
2. Pick a free 2-hour time inside vet hours.
3. Booked card: time, pets to bring, Cancel.
4. 50 🪙 a pet, paid at the vet. Free if you can't pay.
5. Late: book again, free.
6. One list for everyone in the room, same as Nurse Penny's desk.
7. Reminder one game hour before, in the message bar.
Changed: no new home-screen app (a 10th icon falls off the phone screen).
Price and hours: your Economy picks (50 a pet, 7:00-23:00).

comments.text:
Need your OK: pictures added (iPad light, PC dark).
My calls, Redo if wrong: reminder yes, one shared list.
Done: the desk is Nurse Penny's (1 Nov).

short: Book a vet time from the phone's 🐾 Pets app
